speaker: High-chief Zayalu
line_text: High-chief Zayalu Oh? What is this? More humes come to visit us? A little bigger this time, but no matter. You need not tell me anything. I know you have come to our village to learn of the Stones, the nethicite. We garif have knowledge of this, passed down from father to son, mother to daughter. Some of it remains, some has been lost in history's sands... I...know nothing of the Stones. You must speak to the Great-chief. He alone holds the deep knowledge of these things. He alone remembers all the tellings. Cross the bridge to the north, and there you will find him. There are watchers at the bridge, so I think it best to speak with War-chief Supinelu. / High-chief Zayalu ...May I ask of you a favor? Give this to War- chief Supinelu, from me. / High-chief Zayalu There is no rush. When you next happen to meet him, you may give it to him then. May you find all the answers you seek.

speaker: War-chief Supinelu; Ashe

Yet, arranging an audience may be quite difficult... / Ashe I must learn more about the nethicite. I cannot turn back now. / Ashe Please, tell your Great-chief that I am of the royal line of Dalmasca, a direct descendant of Dynast-King Raithwall. If the garif have passed down knowledge of the Stones, they must know of the nethicite that the Dynast-King once held. / War-chief Supinelu Do you have proof of your heritage? / Ashe I...I do not. / War-chief Supinelu Hrm... / War-chief Supinelu I have looked into your eyes and seen that you speak the truth, hume-child. I give you my trust. The Great-chief is ahead, across this bridge.

speaker: Old War-chief Kadalu
line_text: It is important to know the ways of killing your foe, yet the truly great warrior never forgets himself in battle. You are still young. If you would wield a weapon, think first on what of yourself you must defend. / Indeed, the world changes, it moves. Even here in our village we can feel this. Perhaps the time has come for the garif to rise. / What? A mark has been posted for the Catoblepas? I wonder...could it be...? / So it was my brother who posted the mark for the Catoblepas. To think that matter still weighed on his heart after all this time... I had no idea. I have been remiss... / My injury was no other's fault but mine own. I was inexperienced, yet my brother blames what happened on himself. Now his mind is bent on defeating the Catoblepas... He will try to face this beast on his own, but you must aid him. The Catoblepas is not his foe alone...and I would see him return home safely. Please, aid my brother. Aid Supinelu. / So you have fought and defeated the Catoblepas. Somehow, I knew this... No, it was when I saw my brother. The anger that hung like a cloud over his shoulders is gone. The past threw black chains about his heart, yet now he has been released. I thank you. / Ah, you are the humes our War-chief saw on the plains. Welcome to our village, protected by the clear flow of the Sogoht. I am Supinelu's brother, Kadalu. I worry...for Supinelu often goes to the plains alone. Why, when the others surely wish to train with him? He is stubborn this way. Your pardon, I spoke of a personal matter. Please forget it. How might I mend it, if so? / I gave up the title of War-chief when my leg was injured in an attack by the beast known as the Catoblepas. I was not ready, and I paid the price. I accept this. line_text: Ah, it is the great warrior! It is true you have defeated the Catoblepas with our War-chief? This is truly a feat for song. You must tell me everything of the battle next time. line_text: Beyond here lies the hill where sits the Great- chief. Those from the outside are not welcome here. / If the War-chief has given you his trust, so shall I. Go, meet with the Great-chief.

line_text: The Great-chief is across this bridge. Walk softly. / You ask of the enkelados? Ah, yes, this is the mark. Now I recall. First, you must know that the enkelados detests the creatures known as the "wu." To lure it out, you must first rid the area of these wu. Once all the wu are slain, depart a while, and in a short time, the enkelados shall appear. / You have slain the enkelados? This will surely please the Low-chief.

speaker: Garif Warrior
line_text: Adrammelech, and the Catoblepas, defeated! The caverns have been rid of two great menaces, by your hand. Yet, there is menace enough in the world still. To battle a myth and win, it is remarkable. / You, have you heard? Our War-chief has finally defeated the Catoblepas in Zertinan Caverns! How many warriors have tried, all only to fail! The War-chief is the pride of our village! / You seem a great warrior, but it is best you avoid Zertinan Caverns. There are many fell creatures there, and of late, worse... line_text: Can you hear the laughter? The warriors are rejoicing, for the scourge of Zertinan Caverns is no more. / Many people come to our village of late... Perhaps the road to Giza is open? line_text: You have defeated the Catoblepas with our War-chief? This is a good thing you did. You are a traveler, yes? Our village is not like a hume village, but you are welcome to find what comfort here as you may. / I am told that you entered our village with permission of the War-chief? This is most unusual, for he does not take to outsiders. Quite stoic, that one! Hoh! It is his strength, and his weakness. I am afraid it is the weak side that shines most brightly of late. / Tell me, what do you think of our War-chief? He is serious, and ofttimes grim to a fault. Why does he always seek to do everything alone? / I knew the War-chief in his childhood, and I know him well now. When his elder brother, Kadalu, became War-chief, he strove to become strong. Yet, after what the Catoblepas did... I'm sorry, it is a personal matter. Please forget it. / You can speak the tongue of the cockatrice? Then, ask this one why it has come here! / Have you learned anything of the bird? (choices: It came from Giza Plains. / It likes your masks. / Not really.) / Ah, from the lands of the Giza nomads, yes. This is quite a journey for such a bird. Please, tell the Great-chief that we have a visitor from the village of Giza Plains. / Ah! I see, I see. It has been many years since anyone praised my mask. You must thank this cockatrice, for me. / Please, tell the Great-chief that we have a visitor from Giza. The nomads there have helped us a great deal. He will want to hear of this. / Ah, you have told the Great-chief? I thank you. / Many thanks for your aid with the cockatrice! Please, take this. / What could this odd bird be thinking? If I only had that...

speaker: Geomancer Yugelu
line_text: You have defeated the Catoblepas? I know, with- out you saying anything. I know too that the War-chief joined you in this battle. You have done well, brave young warrior. I know too that the War-chief joined you in this battle. You have done well, brave young warrior. For our people, I thank you. / Many hume-children come to our village of late. You, too, have come to learn of this nethicite? We Garif protect the old ways, the old knowledge. Perhaps one of us knows of this Stone. My knowledge, however, is little. I know that nethicite makes the power of magick as nothing, but this is all. But you already knew this, did you not? / All of us, all people have a role. What a sad thing it is that this role is not always what we desire in our life. In this village, too, there is one who rages against the role given him by the heavens... in vain. None may change their fate. / Sitting here on the earth, one comes to see many things: the great flow of the world, even the flow of Man's thoughts... / The stick you gave to our War-chief has the power to ward off evil things. Our War-chief fights against a great monster, possessed of immense power. May that wood grow in his heart and make him strong. / Our War-chief fights against a great monster, possessed of immense power. He may not be able to defeat it alone, yet the War-chief seeks no aid of others. He believes it is his duty to destroy the creature. / No matter what your reasons may be, it is a wrong thing to harm others and to take life. This is a truth. / An old story of our people tells that "Zertinan" in an ancient tongue means "abyss," or "under- world." From here, by our village, all the way to the northern continent, I can feel it tremble. / I sense a great power, an aura, about you. Use your power for what is right. However mighty you become, know this: that the path of pride leads only to sorrow. Take care your path is the true path, and I shall pray for you. / Deep within the Henne Mines, a great power lies sleeping. Venture into the depths... Perhaps you will find this power, and master it. Perhaps you will find this power, and master it. Or perhaps you will fail, and die. I will send a garif warrior to open the way. I warn you: do not undertake this lightly. This power is greater than anything you can imagine. / You! You are...never mind. You have come to ask about the Henne Mines? Deep within the mines, a great power lies sleeping. Venture into the depths... Perhaps you will find this power, and master it. Or perhaps you will fail, and die. I will send a garif warrior to open the way. I warn you: do not undertake this lightly. This power is greater than anything you can imagine. / I know of your skill, by which you defeated the mindflayer. I know of your heart, by which you saved a youth of our village. Because of these things, I thought to guide you to the depths of the Henne Mines...but no, I feel it is yet too soon. You would not be able to quell the great power that lies sleeping in Henne Mines, not as you are now. To grasp such power, and hold it, you first need gather about you the protection of many great beings. Do this, and return to me. / A great power lies sleeping deep within the Henne Mines. Yet...as you are now, you lack the strength to master such a thing.

speaker: Garif Elder; High-chief Zayalu
line_text: I hear the Catoblepas has fallen! This is truly a joyous occasion! Our War-chief who fought with you knows joy as well, I am certain. The Catoblepas long troubled his heart. / High-chief Zayalu The stick you gave to our War-chief, it is a ward against demons, known to our people. I fear he will have need of it soon... / High-chief Zayalu Our Great-chief, he will know of the nethicite. If he tells you he does not know, then you must abandon your search, for no one knows. Ah, also, I must ask you to give the jaya stick to our War-chief. Now, I hope you will find the knowledge you seek. / To the garif, magicite is most holy. We have worshiped the Stones since the beginning of time, and their tale is told in our legends. Yet, there is much we still do not know. What is this nethicite? Its very name speaks of dark power, yet it is a mystery to us. / Supinelu has only been War-chief a short while. Yet he is too earnest, I think. His enthusiasm is well meant, but wasted. I would aid him... / Do you know the creature called the Catoblepas? The warriors of our village have attempted to slay it many times, never with success. / That cockatrice... Why do I feel I have seen it somewhere before? / Ah, that is it. Many cockatrices are kept in the village on Giza Plains, yes. Perhaps it is one from their herd? / High-chief Zayalu You have come to learn of the nethicite? Then you must speak with the Great-chief. You will find him across the bridge to the north. Also, might I ask a small favor? I have something to give the War-chief. (choices: Accept / Decline) / High-chief Zayalu Then, please do this for me. Show him what you bear, and the War-chief will understand. / High-chief Zayalu I see... Very well, it is no great matter. You must go and speak with the Great-chief, after all.

speaker: Garif Elder
line_text: You may ask me three more times, or a hundred, and each time I will tell you, "I do not know." Perhaps the Great-chief would know of this nethicite? He is wise in the knowledge of our people. You would do well to speak with him. / Hmm, nethicite... Perhaps the Great-chief knows something. He is across the bridge to the north. You would do best to speak to the War-chief before attempting to cross. The warriors guarding the bridge are his. / You may ask me three more times, or a hundred, and each time I will tell you, "I do not know." ...Perhaps the High-chief knows something of this? If you have not spoken with him yet, go. He will be with Geomancer Yugelu. / You have the look of one who wishes to know something. If it is something that I know, good. Ah, the nethicite... You are not the only one who has asked me about this. It saddens me to admit that I know nothing of this Stone. Magicite contains within it a great power, thus have we worshipped the Stones from the beginning of time. Yet I had never heard of this nethicite... Perhaps the High-chief knows something of this? If you have not spoken with him yet, go. He will be with Geomancer Yugelu. / Nethicite...the name alone speaks of much power. These Stones must be very special indeed. Yet I know nothing. Ask the other elders. / You have the look of one who wishes to know something. If it is something that I know, good. Ah, the nethicite... You are not the only one who has asked me about this. He is wise in the knowledge of our people. You would do well to speak with him.

I have heard that a wyrm lives there, a legendary creature from the time of the gods.

Only the skeletons of the ships remain, and they tell no tales. / To the east of here lies Paramina Rift. On days when the snows are heavy, the creatures known as elementals can be seen there. Take care, for they are quite dangerous, and unfond of Man.

However, even though it be evil...it was still kin. Yet, how surprised I was to see you, who are known to us, come to our aid. Perhaps this was the wish of our ancestors, now fulfilled. / High-chief Zayalu You have saved the spirits of our ancestors from eternal darkness. You have all our gratitude.

speaker: Garif Youth
line_text: Ah, a hume-child. I am surprised to see you here. This hill is called the elderknoll. Here does the Great-chief hold counsel with the other elders. We garif welcome outsiders to our village, but few are they who are allowed here. You must be on important business indeed. / Hrm? Do you find my mask odd? You may look upon it all you wish, yet I will not take it off, lend it, or sell it. All garif receive a mask the day they are born, not to be removed until the day they die. This has always been our custom. / The wisdom of the village is passed down through words. I am still young, and there is much I do not know, so I must listen to what the elders say. / The horror of Zertinan Caverns has been defeated! Our War-chief is a strong warrior. I knew he would prevail someday! / You have traveled to many places, I hear. Have you seen snow? It is like silk to the eye, yet cold to the touch, is it not? I have heard that snow falls in the forest to the southeast of our village, but the elders warn against going there. They say this forest is a place of twisting paths that addle the senses. I do not think I shall go.

line_text: I will accompany you to Mt Bur-Omisace.

line_text: I had other reason to invite you. / There is someone I'd like you to meet waiting on Bur-Omisace.

line_text: Who is that?

speaker: Larsa
line_text: An enemy, and an ally also. / You will just have to wait and see for yourself.

speaker: Vaan
line_text: That Larsa likes his secrets.

line_text: He's not bad. / At least for an Imperial.

speaker: Basch
line_text: Holy Mt Bur-Omisace stands at the northern end of the Jagd Ramooda.

speaker: Basch
line_text: Once we're in jagd, we need not fear pursuit by their airships.

speaker: Balthier
line_text: Don't get your hopes up.

speaker: Balthier
line_text: You remember the Leviathan sailed straight over the Jagd Yensa, right up to Raithwall's tomb.

speaker: Balthier
line_text: Skystone that works even in jagd. / You know nethicite's behind it.

speaker: Balthier
line_text: Little wonder they're so keen on the stuff.

speaker: Basch
line_text: And what is it you're after, Balthier? / You're a welcome hand, and a great aid, but why?

speaker: Balthier
line_text: Worried I'm out to steal the nethicite, eh? / Can't say I'm unaccustomed to people doubting my intentions.

speaker: Balthier
line_text: Nothing could be further from my mind. / Shall I swear by your sword or some such?

speaker: Basch
line_text: Apologies. But I needed to know where you stand. / Her Majesty depends on you.

speaker: Basch
line_text: And you seemed to have an interest in the Stone.

speaker: Balthier
line_text: I'm only here to see how the story unfolds. / Any self-respecting leading man would do the same.

line_text: This nethicite— you have used it.

speaker: Ashe
line_text: It was not I who used it. / Indeed I had hoped you could show me how. Thus I've come.

speaker: ELDER_GALIF (script label); Ashe
line_text: You do not know the workings of the Stone. / Then we are no different. / What?

speaker: ELDER_GALIF (script label)
line_text: In ages past, the gods made a gift of nethicite to my people. / But the manner of its use eluded us.

speaker: ELDER_GALIF (script label)
line_text: Displeased by our failure, the gods took back their Stones. / They chose instead to give them to a hume king.

speaker: ELDER_GALIF (script label)
line_text: Called the Dynast-King, he used the nethicite's power to bring peace to a troubled time.

speaker: ELDER_GALIF (script label)
line_text: It is a curious thing. / Though the blood of King Raithwall flow through your veins, you cannot wield nethicite.

speaker: Ashe
line_text: Cannot wield it? / So then, am I to understand you can't tell me how to use the Stone?

speaker: ELDER_GALIF (script label)
line_text: Though it shame me so to admit.

speaker: ELDER_GALIF (script label)
line_text: Here before me stands a descendant of the Dynast-King himself... / and I can accord her no help at all.

speaker: ELDER_GALIF (script label)
line_text: Still, even if you knew how to use the nethicite, you would find it of small avail.

speaker: ELDER_GALIF (script label)
line_text: The Mist collected in the Stone over ages past is lost, and with it the Stone's power.

speaker: ELDER_GALIF (script label)
line_text: It will be your posterity who wield the Stone in ages yet to come.

speaker: ELDER_GALIF (script label); no name shown
line_text: This Stone is devoid of power. / Empty, yet full of thirst. / A terrible longing to drink the world dry.

speaker: ELDER_GALIF (script label)
line_text: A terrible longing to drink the world dry.

speaker: ELDER_GALIF (script label)
line_text: The power of men, and of magick. / Of good, and of evil.

speaker: ELDER_GALIF (script label)
line_text: It is often those who desire nethicite whom the nethicite itself desires.

speaker: Penelo
line_text: Larsa?

speaker: Ashe
line_text: To Bur-Omisace?

speaker: LARSAR (script label)
line_text: I say we ought leave tomorrow.

speaker: LARSAR (script label)
line_text: I was going to wait for my escort to return, but meeting you here has presented a great opportunity.

speaker: LARSAR (script label)
line_text: This terrible war can be stopped, but I will need your help to do so.

speaker: Ashe
line_text: A war?

speaker: LARSAR (script label)
line_text: You know the Marquis Ondore leads a group of insurgents— / your pardon, he leads a large resistance force against the Empire. / Lady Ashe, neither of our countries can afford this now. / The Rozarrian Empire would stir.

speaker: LARSAR (script label)
line_text: They would aid the Resistance and use this aid as a pretext to declare war on Archadia... / and Archadia would have no choice but to answer.

speaker: LARSAR (script label)
line_text: Lady Ashe, let us go to Bur-Omisace.

speaker: LARSAR (script label)
line_text: With the blessing of His Grace the Gran Kiltias Anastasis...

speaker: LARSAR (script label)
line_text: you may rightly wear your crown, and declare the restoration of the Kingdom of Dalmasca.

speaker: LARSAR (script label)
line_text: As queen, you can call for peace between the Empire and Dalmasca... / and stop Marquis Ondore.

speaker: Ashe
line_text: For peace?

speaker: Ashe
line_text: How dare you say that!

speaker: Ashe
line_text: The Empire attacked us, stole all we hold dear... / and you would have me save them from war?

speaker: LARSAR (script label)
line_text: Dalmasca would be the battlefield!

speaker: LARSAR (script label)
line_text: What if nethicite were used on Rabanastre? / You know my brother would do this!

speaker: LARSAR (script label)
line_text: Forgive me, I presumed overmuch. / I could think of no other way to avoid bloodshed.

speaker: LARSAR (script label)
line_text: If you cannot trust me, then please, take me as your hostage.

speaker: Ashe
line_text: Rasler.

speaker: Vaan
line_text: You saw him, didn't you. / Like at the king's tomb.

speaker: Ashe
line_text: So you did see him, too. / But why?

speaker: Vaan
line_text: It's strange.

speaker: Vaan
line_text: Before, I didn't even know what you looked like.

speaker: Vaan
line_text: And the Prince— I barely knew there was a prince.

speaker: Vaan
line_text: Who knows? / Maybe the person I saw was my brother.

speaker: Ashe
line_text: Basch told me about him.

speaker: Vaan
line_text: He enlisted, right at the end. / But for what? He knew we couldn't win.

speaker: Ashe
line_text: To protect something.

speaker: Vaan
line_text: How can he protect anything when he's dead?

speaker: Vaan
line_text: Was it different for Prince Rasler? / Did that make sense?

speaker: Vaan
line_text: Hating the Empire, getting revenge. / It's all I ever thought about.

speaker: Vaan
line_text: But I never did anything about it.

speaker: Vaan
line_text: I mean, I realized there was nothing I could do. / It made me feel hollow, alone.

speaker: Vaan
line_text: And then I'd miss my brother.

speaker: Vaan
line_text: I'd say stuff like "I'm gonna be a sky pirate"...

speaker: Vaan
line_text: or some other stupid thing. / Just anything to keep my mind off it.

speaker: Vaan
line_text: I was just— / I was running away.

speaker: Vaan
line_text: I needed to get away from his death. That's why I followed you.

speaker: Vaan
line_text: Know what? I'm through with it. / I'm through running.

speaker: Vaan
line_text: I'm ready to find my purpose. / To find some real answers— some reasons.

speaker: Vaan
line_text: If I stick with you, I think I will.

speaker: Ashe
line_text: I wish I knew.

speaker: Vaan
line_text: I'll find 'em.
